The overall sum of stones across all bags stays constant across operations, but individual bag values change as stones are transferred.
The stones are removed from the source bag (which becomes 0) and added to (combined with) the destination bag's existing stones.
Operations may be performed any number of times in any order and any sequence, with no ordering restrictions.
Yes, a bag becomes completely empty (0 stones) immediately after all its stones are moved out.
No, any two distinct bags among the N bags may be chosen for an operation.
Bags with zero stones simply contribute 0 to the XOR, computed the same as any other value via standard bitwise XOR.
The XOR result is treated as its integer value, so representations differing only by leading zeros are the same value, not different.
